title: M4 — Remediation of Epoch 2 (Tools) review findings

baseline.notes: Existing tool_driver passes, but contains concurrency races, lack of proper timeout cancelation (orphan child processes), and missing required harness test and driver files.

stages.title: Fix Local_env.Sh.exec concurrency and timeout handling
stages.description: Refactor Local_env.Sh.exec to eliminate the background reader race condition and ensure child processes are terminated promptly on timeout or cancellation.
implementation_notes: Use structured concurrency via a sub-switch inside exec to wrap the process lifecycle.
Run the stdout reader, stderr reader, and process awaiter in parallel using Eio.Fiber.all to guarantee readers are fully joined before returning.
Ensure that when a timeout or cancellation occurs, the sub-switch is cancelled, which automatically terminates the child process and closes resources.
coding_guidelines_to_emphasize: eio.md — sub-switch for process lifecycle, Eio.Fiber.all for parallel streams
error-handling.md — map Eio.Time.Timeout to correct Timeout code

stages.title: Add missing Stage 2 harness files
stages.description: Create local_env_sh_test.ml and env_driver.ml to complete the specified harness layer.
implementation_notes: Create lib/pera_harness/test/local_env_sh_test.ml with tests for basic command execution, timeout behavior, and PATH scanning.
Create bin/drivers/env_driver.ml to exercise the harness layer standalone and output PASS/FAIL verdicts.
Update the respective dune files to compile these newly created targets.

test_requirements.test_command: eval $(opam env) && dune runtest lib/pera_harness && dune exec ./bin/drivers/env_driver.exe

coding_guidelines_to_emphasize: test-patterns.md — Arrange-Act-Assert structure, explicit test cases

stages.title: Align bash_tool output formatting and empty fallback
stages.description: Refactor bash_tool to match the specified template for non-zero exit codes and output representation when empty.
implementation_notes: Check if command output is empty; if so, return '(no output)' in the Tool_text.
Align non-zero exit code message formatting with the spec template: '<output>\n\nCommand exited with code <exit_code>.'
coding_guidelines_to_emphasize: error-handling.md — clear separation between code and message formatting

stages.title: Centralize shared helpers and resolve minor code smells
stages.description: Consolidate duplicated error and test utilities to clean up codebase duplication.
implementation_notes: Move file_error_to_tool_error from grep_tool.ml to tool_util.ml and export via tool_util.mli.
Centralize make_temp_dir, cleanup, and write_file from individual test files into test_util.ml.
Remove the unused 'fpath' dependency from lib/pera_tools/dune if no longer needed.

pera-specific.md — open Containers in every .ml, no String.get
